en-US.author: CosimoScott
en-US.longDescription:
See your thoughts like never before with Filamental.

Filamental allows you to place your thoughts, connect them and present them
in a way that is both intuitive and has depth.

Create connected networks, networked documents, documented knowledge.

Limited only by your imagination, add anything, link to anything, share to
anyone.

Designed For You
Work in 3D or 2D, use physics to keep control, switch between an infinite
space and publishing. Then add themes, colors, tables, columns, images and
backgrounds to enhance your work and make it land.

Privacy By Default
Did we mention we don't hold your data, IP, documents and personal info
hostage? We don't do that. Your data stays on your machine, under your
control and you decide where it goes. It is literally impossible for us to
gather or see.

AI On Your Terms
Connect your own AI, we don't force you to use a cheap knock-off we
rebranded. It's easy and it's your choice.

Read-Write-Collaborate
Filamental is powerful when acting as a companion to AI, allowing you to
compile and create astonishing constellations. Even if AI isn't your thing,
you might want to give it a second chance.

Free forever and paid options.

Features:
- Easy and intuitive navigation and UI
- Quickly switch between building and publishing
- Huge range of customization options for beautiful documents
- Share and open anywhere using links or HTML files
- 2D and 3D views
- Custom categories and structured properties
- Custom connector types with directional arrows, labels, colors, weights
- Local MCP connection and BYOK brings the power of AI to creating and
  understanding your work
- Wikilink and Mermaid compatibility
- Insert any files of any type to link them into your project
- Folder bridges jump between your spaces
- All local. You set the terms. You choose where your data resides - not us.
- Built-in help playground, feature suggestions, bug reporting and granular
  adjustments

en-US.releaseNotes:
- New Constellations: save how you've arranged your nodes, with the camera and the 2D or 3D view, under a name, from the camera button at the top left of the graph
- Ctrl+0 saves a constellation and Ctrl+1 to Ctrl+9 load the first nine, gliding the nodes and camera back into place
- New Straighten, under the 2D/3D toggle, lays a lit Pathfinder route out in a line, with everything else arranged round it
- A lit route lists in the right panel as a chain, each arrow pointing its real way, and reverses with one click
- What's New opens once after each update, and Esc or a click outside closes it
